items.title: 21.5 Halogenoarenes (ring par halogen wale compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.5, printed page 81.

blocks.text: Chlorobenzene aur bromobenzene jaise halogenoarenes benzene ko chlorine ya bromine se react kara kar banaye jate hain. Is mein catalyst anhydrous (bilkul khushk, paani ke baghair) FeCl₃ ya FeBr₃ hota hai. Is reaction ko electrophilic aromatic substitution kehte hain, aur yeh aam taur par room temperature (kamre ke temperature) par hota hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene, jis ka aik H dikhaya gaya, + X2, arrow ke oopar FeX3, se halobenzene (us H ki jagah X) + HX.
blocks.caption: Preparation of halogenoarenes (halogenoarenes banana) (kitab ke PDF page 84 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene ring ka ek H nikal jata hai aur us ki jagah X (Cl ya Br) aa jata hai; nikla hua H, X ke doosre atom se mil kar HX banata hai. Ring waisi ki waisi rehti hai, is liye yeh substitution hai, addition nahi.

blocks.prompt: Benzene se chlorobenzene kis type ke reaction se banta hai?
blocks.explanation: Electrophilic aromatic substitution se: benzene + Cl₂, anhydrous FeCl₃ catalyst ke saath, room temperature par.

items: Benzene + Cl₂ ya Br₂ (FeX₃ catalyst) → halogenoarene + HX; electrophilic aromatic substitution.
